messages.content: How many heads can I get after tossing 3 coins?

message.content:
With three fair coins tossed once, the number of heads you can observe ranges from **0 to 3**.  
In other words, the possible outcomes are:

| Heads | Probability |
|-------|-------------|
| 0     | 1/8 (12.5 %) |
| 1     | 3/8 (37.5 %) |
| 2     | 3/8 (37.5 %) |
| 3     | 1/8 (12.5 %) |

So you could end up with 0, 1, 2, or 3 heads.
